scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2 (General States), Chapter 6: Linear Decision Processes. Weak and strong Feller kernels (Example 6.1.1, Lemma 6.1.1 with Scheffe's lemma, Example 6.1.2); linear decision processes as additive ADPs on bX, lifetime values (6.6), Examples 6.1.3-6.1.6; optimality for finite LDPs (Proposition 6.1.2, with regularity by pasting policies) and Feller LDPs (Proposition 6.1.3, greedy policies (6.8) and the Bellman operator (6.9)); exogenous discount processes (Lemma 6.1.4 as a path expectation, Lemma 6.1.5, Exercise 6.1.1, Proposition 6.1.6 with a measurable discount operator); Markov decision processes on general state spaces (Proposition 6.1.7, Example 6.1.8); natural resource management (Proposition 6.2.1), stochastic rates of return (Section 6.2.2) and mortality (Exercise 6.2.1); the maximum theorem with a Borel selection for interval correspondences (Exercise A.3.1, Theorem A.3.3); with the earlier chapters' ADP theory and the Banach lattice bX restated.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2: General States, Chapter 6, pp. 184-206, with the Appendix A results used there.
